_comment: Job scraping configuration — proxy rotation, rate limits, retries

proxy._paid_note: If mode=paid-api, set paid_api_url to your proxy provider's endpoint (e.g. ScraperAPI, Bright Data)

wireguard._note: WireGuard is a VPN tunnel, not natively an HTTP/SOCKS proxy. Two ways to expose it:
wireguard._note_endpoints: 'endpoints' = local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy ports exposed by WireSock/tun2socks that route via a WG tunnel (format: 'socks5://127.0.0.1:1080' or 'http://127.0.0.1:1080')
wireguard._note_tunnels: 'tunnels' = WireGuard tunnel NAMES (as in the WG app) to toggle between system-VPN style. Wraps each scrape batch in an activate/deactivate cycle.

rate_limit._jitter_note: Random additional delay up to this many seconds to avoid predictable patterns

retry._retry_on_empty_note: If true, retries even when 0 results returned (may indicate blocking)
